intake.risk_question: What is the risk that CVE-2026-85880 is exploited on Northbridge Services assets, given environment snapshot northbridge-v1.1 (as of 2026-10-01)?

threat.description: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows ALPC allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

kev.required_action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
kev.note: absence from KEV does not establish safety

threat.severity_note: CVSS is the flaw's technical severity in general; the decision per asset is local risk from the applicability-and-impact policy.

assumptions: A6 (S07): W15 is reachable from the USERS zone (flow F07), so its exposure is "intranet"
A15 (S07): Payroll operators (non-administrators) log on to W15 to run exports, and the NTLM service account `svc_finlegacy` runs there, so a low-privilege local access path exists

confidence.reason: decisive facts rely on group-simulated evidence S07, S08

action.recommended_action: 1) Deploy the Microsoft security update to bring the OS to build 10.0.14393.9512 or later. 2) Review and restrict NTLM usage, especially for the svc_finlegacy account, and enforce stronger password rotation (service account password age). 3) Verify that the patch approval was recorded at least 60 days before the snapshot and document compliance with CISA BOD 26‑04. Note: the federal KEV due date of 2026‑09‑22 has already passed.
action.would_change_decision: Evidence that the system has been upgraded to build ≥ 10.0.14393.9512 (or that low‑privilege local access has been eliminated) would resolve the High rating.
